name: cfd-pdo-convolution-layer-design
description: 面向具有连续群对称性的PDE数据，设计基于偏微分算子（PDO）的等变卷积层的知识卡片。PDO卷积通过将偏微分算子嵌入卷积核实现群等变性，适用于SO(2)/SE(2)等连续对称群，支持2D和3D可转向卷积。涵盖PDO-eConvs与PDO-s3DCNNs两个架构变体。

evidence_papers.title: PDO-eConvs: Partial Differential Operator Based Equivariant Convolutions
PDO-s3DCNNs: Partial Differential Operator Based Steerable 3D CNNs
